text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-M-05, Modern Sartre Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob

There are many things that can be inspirational, and the Sartre Pull by Acorn is one of them. Let this stainless steel cabinet pull fuel your modern decor dreams. The unique, flowing shape paired with the sleek brushed stainless steel finish make the Sartre Cabinet Knob a wonderful accent to every room in your home.

Also Available Matching Sartre Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Modern Sartre Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
